items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: with New Orleans, Harlem Kings, we, rap and I played a duet with two guitars.

ctx.x: Yeah, when we made that recording in Indianapolis, at the time, you know, with the big band, that you played some guitar duets with rap.

Yeah, when we made that recording in Indianapolis, at the time, you know, with the big band, that we, with New Orleans, Harlem Kings, we, rap and I played a duet with two guitars. He played the blues and I made the accompaniments, you know, behind him. But we made the recording, but I never heard anything of it. Did he play much? No, I never heard nothing of it. Did he play much? In fact, Carol Pierce, some of the musicians says they heard it, but I never did hear. Carol Pierce, I heard a piano, because we had…
Oh, no. Yeah. The guitar never came out though. Maybe it was a test record. You got Marguerite? Yeah. Yeah. Well, that goes to show it. A lot of people have that. Not a lot, but a few.
